Turns the music on or off. The button in the title bar does the same thing.|||开关音乐。标题栏上那个按钮效果一样。
ON = the song repeats forever. OFF = it moves on to the next song in your playlist when it ends.|||开 = 单曲无限循环。关 = 放完后自动跳到播放列表的下一首。
ON = the next song is picked at random. Works with the ⏭ / ⏮ buttons and when a song ends (Loop OFF).|||开 = 下一首随机挑。⏭ / ⏮ 按钮和歌曲放完时（单曲循环关）都生效。
ON = your last song starts playing when the hub opens. Turn OFF if you want silence at the start.|||开 = 打开 Hub 时自动放上一首。想安静开局就关掉。
How loud the music is (0 = silent, 100 = max).|||音乐多大声音（0 = 静音，100 = 最大）。
